snippet.title: For Mother Matron - Anniversary Trailer
snippet.description:
Lizzy is a girl living in The Boarding, a walled city surrounded by fog. All who live here serve the mysterious Mother Matron, its revered leader who hasn’t been seen in person in many years. Periodically, the Mother Matron selects residents to become Surveyors, tasked with exploring the dark unknown tunnels that lie underground to find the key to a better future for the collective. The odds of survival are slim to none. It is an honor and a death sentence. One day, Lizzy finds herself on the draft...

Using your wits and quick thinking, you must guide Lizzy through the dangers beneath. Will you survive? Will you find Paradise? Or will you be lost to the dark forever?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2162960/For_Mother_Matron/
https://velvetique.itch.io/for-mother-matron
----------

This took longer than I wanted, but it's finally here! For Mother Matron needed some tender love and care, so I went back to improve it while adding a few new things to make a return visit more enjoyable. If you were looking for new story stuff, that is unfortunately not this update... that's for the future! 

READ PATCH NOTES & MORE INFO ABOUT THE FUTURE HERE:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2162960/view/616557663605489676?l=english

Thank you to everyone who's played my game and left feedback! Good or bad, it's all motivated me to keep creating and I hope I get to make many more games and experiences. 

My Website:
https://www.velvetiquegames.com/

Follow Neoclassic Games On Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/neoclassicgames
